title.en: Block in the head and body

hint.en: Draw a circle for the head and a big oval for the body. Add a curved line for the tail and ovals for the back leg, plus small ovals for the paws.
Add a curved centre line and a slanted eye line across the head. Mark two circles for the eyes, an oval for the muzzle, and a triangle for each ear.
Trace the outline of the head with its fluffy cheek fur, then the two pointed ears with their inner shapes.
Draw the big round eyes with pupils, the little nose and mouth, the dark muzzle shape and the whiskers.
Follow the neck and chest down the side of the body, then add a few short fur strokes on the tummy.

title.en: Ink the legs, paws and tail

hint.en: Finish with the front legs, the round paws and the curled tail, then add small fur marks.

colorHint.en: Cream body with dark chocolate-brown face, ears, legs and tail. Soft pale blue eyes.
